name: SoCalGas Calexico Crossing
monitor_reason: length: the only source is one EIA release row stating 30 mi for a line that crosses into Mexico, so the US-side length is unsourced; a second EIA row for a 1997 Calexico/Mexicali crossing lists only 0.25 mi. Also the project was completed in 1998 and no second source was found.
researcher_notes: The Southern California Gas Company Calexico crossing appears in the EIA natural gas pipeline projects release for August 2026, Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 97, as SoCal Calixico Crossing: new pipeline, completed November 1998, 30 miles, 16 inches, state authority, California to Mexico. The same sheet at row 33 lists a SoCal Calexico/Mexicali Crossing expansion completed July 1997 at 0.25 miles. The 30 miles may include the Mexican side, and the two rows suggest the US border crossing itself is very short. No row for this line exists in the roster. The only SoCalGas row, P6233, is the whole 3,640 mile system, so this is not a match to an existing row. Web search was unavailable (session limit), so no independent source, FERC filing or California regulator document was found. Under the length rule this stays on monitor until a sourced US-side length of at least 25 km (15.5 mi) is found. Low confidence.
